posts.headline: Celebrate the 30th Anniversary of a Classic Puzzle Game with 'Rush Hour Duel'

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the grid, cars, and challenge cards carry a feed post on their own

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: puzzle crowd wants the anniversary link itself, preview does the work

posts.blurb: Rush Hour, the sliding-car logic puzzle that has sold fifteen million copies, turns thirty this year with a head-to-head spinoff: same gridlock, now someone else is racing you out of it.
posts.why: Puzzle design that has stayed sharp for thirty years and just got sharper into a competitive format — our exact genre.

posts.headline: All The Trains I Rode In Los Angeles

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: the premise is the whole post, link preview carries it

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.why: essay-length travel writing needs a sentence of setup before the click

posts.blurb: A writer spent ten days in Los Angeles trying to get everywhere by train. The trains work fine. It is the city built around them that keeps fighting back.
posts.why: The closest thing to what our players actually do — impose one rule on a city and see what it costs you.

posts.headline: More than 300 people show up to break hammock world records in Swan Valley

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: a field full of hammocks is a feed post on its own

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: the record number is the whole hook, link preview does the rest

posts.blurb: Swan Valley, Idaho got 350 people into hammocks at once this month, breaking two Guinness records that nobody knew existed until someone tried for them.
posts.why: The same earnest, slightly absurd energy as wife-carrying or conker championships — strangers organizing around one shared task.

posts.headline: Take a peek at Long Beach's past through this 1976 time capsule

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.why: hometown history needs a sentence of setup, and the audience skews local

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the artifact photos, a Frisbee and a vial of crude oil, carry a feed post

posts.blurb: Long Beach cracked open a time capsule buried for its 1976 bicentennial, and the schoolkids who wrote letters inside came back fifty years later to read their own predictions out loud.
posts.why: A whole city treated as a puzzle box on a fifty-year fuse — the same instinct behind a good route.

posts.headline: Brandi Carlile, Ms. Lauryn Hill, CMAT, Tom Morello, Punch Brothers, Hot Tuna, Dave Matthews & More Highlight 2026 Newport Folk Festival

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the festival photo gallery is strong enough to carry a feed post or a Story

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.why: the fort's sixty-year folk history needs a sentence of setup before the click

posts.blurb: Newport Folk Festival has run inside a nineteenth-century coastal fort since Dylan went electric there in 1965, and this year Ms. Lauryn Hill played it acoustic.
posts.why: A real venue with real history you can walk into, anchoring one of the country's best festival lineups.
